concepts.learning_objective: Explain the special features of a company such as separate legal entity, limited liability and perpetual succession.
Distinguish companies by the liability of members and by the number of members, including the One Person Company.
Distinguish authorised, issued, subscribed, called-up, paid-up, uncalled and reserve capital.
Show share capital correctly in the Notes to Accounts of a company's balance sheet.
State the preferential rights that define a preference share under Section 43 of the Companies Act, 2013.
Explain the rights of equity shareholders in dividend and in repayment of capital.
Describe the steps of a share issue: prospectus, receipt of applications and allotment.
Apply the minimum subscription rule to decide whether a company may allot shares.
Explain how Applications Supported by Blocked Amount (ASBA) work for application money.

topics.title: Journal Entries for Application, Allotment and Calls

concepts.learning_objective: Record journal entries for application, allotment and calls on shares issued at par.
Apply Table F rules on the amount, interval and notice of calls.
Account for calls in arrears and calls in advance, including interest on them.

topics.title: Over Subscription, Premium and Shares for Consideration other than Cash

concepts.learning_objective: Account for over subscription by rejection, pro-rata allotment or both, and for under subscription.
Record shares issued at a premium and state the uses of Securities Premium and the limits on issue at a discount.
Calculate and record shares issued to vendors for consideration other than cash.
Record the forfeiture of shares issued at par or at a premium.
Record the reissue of forfeited shares and work out the amount transferred to capital reserve.
